label: P10_Q floor question r1
hypothesis: General rules 57/58/63: the calibrated floor question ('What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?') made P11 name its true floor; never asked on P10, never in any round 1. The record's band ended at 31.00 (673ee890 backoffice). If the segment manager names a lower price than her usual 31.50 in round 1, round 2 (36-month move + labour, ask 3.5% under it, a +0.5 move from our 29.40) takes the usual ~0.35 step from there: 31.00 -> ~30.65 (> 0.741). If she ignores it (31.50), round 2 = 59c8's move at 30.40 + the floor question for the final.

rounds.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010).
Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

We therefore propose EUR 29.40 per piece. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

We propose EUR {price} per piece. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
